entities.name: Émilie Gomis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Émilie Gomis is a French-Senegalese professional basketball player playing point guard position. She played for Fenerbahçe of the TWBL league. She wore the number 4. Competing for France, she won a silver medal at the 2012 Summer Olympics.
